runtime_overlay.application: Install numpy==2.3.5 with --no-deps after uv sync --frozen; preserve the original Isaac Lab lock bytes and use this same overlay for the allocation and both FlashSAC recipes.

mdp.asset_resolution: Root approved unchanged actual Isaac Sim6.2 USD and dependency closure staged under ISAACSIM_ASSET_ROOT; record full asset inventory SHA, resolved USD SHA, root environment and task cfg path in every run.
mdp.graph_scope: Newton physics graph and native learning graph are separate; Torch MDP and orchestration remain outside a single combined graph.

design.scope: Current Isaac manager Cartpole with Newton/MJWarp; not the authors DMC Cartpole task or a reproduction of its results.

allocation.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

official_flashsac.precision: Torch FP16 AMP, FP32 master parameters
official_flashsac.n_step_override_reason: One-step returns align pristine authors fixed gamma^n with native effective gamma^k at real time-limit truncations without patching either implementation.

smoke.extra_iteration_purpose: Perturb model/optimizer, restore the earlier full checkpoint exactly, then prove finite updating continuation; no full simulator/RNG trajectory restoration claim.
smoke.required_health: Finite changed actor/critic, coherent optimizer/scaler counters, exact full checkpoint payload reload after a real perturbation, positive post-load actor/critic updates, all first-episode evaluations finite.
smoke.scope: All four standard8-iteration64-world smokes run first in case order; each uses its own execution protocol and capacity, then production starts fresh. Seed1 cases still smoke seed0 because the unchanged controller fixes smoke seed0; all canonical seeds remain present.

initialization.flashsac: Reuse the exact prior pristine authors actor/critic/target/BN/temperature archive per seed, loaded identically into each fresh official/native process. Do not resume any old model or optimizer.
initialization.flash_replay_warmup_actions: Both FlashSAC recipes execute uniform[-1,1] actions from a separate Torch generator seeded seed+90000 while replay is not ready, then use the actual stochastic agent API. Readiness is checked before action selection and after insertion for updates. The main prefix is98 uniform-action vector steps: first updates follow the insertion at zero-based step97; the first policy action is at zero-based step98.
initialization.fresh_reset_state_note: Optimizer counters/moments and replay start empty; dynamic scalers start at their configured initial scale, not numerical zero.
initialization.scope: Only the original per-seed canonical initial FlashSAC archive is loaded. No old trained policy, optimizer, replay or simulation trajectory is resumed.

schedule.balanced: Seed0 small then large; seed1 large then small. Each capacity occupies each within-seed position once. Directed within-seed predecessors occur once each.
schedule.limitation: Cross-seed boundaries and shared compiler-cache histories are not balanced. Two paired seeds on one GPU provide a descriptive pilot, not independent-allocation replication or significance.

evaluation.settled_upright_time_fraction: sum(active_before_step AND abs(wrap(post_step_pole_angle))<0.2 for zero-based steps60..299)/(128*240)
evaluation.failure_mask: Each terminated/truncated first episode is masked permanently; later automatic-reset episodes never contribute. Early failure contributes zero upright time for all remaining budget steps.
evaluation.terminal_observation: Use pre-reset final_obs on done steps; never measure the auto-reset observation.
evaluation.clean_timeout: truncated AND NOT terminated on the first completed episode
evaluation.angle_denominator: Report wrapped angle/RMS over active first-episode steps with active-step counts; full-budget upright fraction and survival expose early failures.
evaluation.time_to_threshold: First saved checkpoint passing the unchanged gate, interval censored between adjacent saved checkpoints; never interpolate. Initial success is left censored; no pass by1000 is right censored.
evaluation.sustained_success: Require the gate at both900 and1000 for sustained success; retain first/ever/best/final separately.
evaluation.process_scope: One fresh128-world evaluator per production run scores all11portable checkpoints from exactly the original128states; no optimizer or BN-state updates.

timing.primary: Full training-process wall through final checkpoint, plus separately itemized complete evaluation-process wall; show their sum as matched end-to-end run protocol wall.
timing.startup: Imports, simulator/asset/env initialization, learner construction, initial-state loads, compilation/capture, learner warmup, initial checkpoint save.
timing.training_loop: All1000iterations including collection, learning, host metrics/logging and checkpoint IO; no trimmed first-iteration costs.
timing.checkpoint_availability: Record process-relative monotonic time when checkpoint writes finish; do not claim durable storage without explicit fsync. Time-to-threshold uses this wall and cumulative recorded training-loop wall as separate axes.
timing.evaluation: Record environment startup, checkpoint load, policy inference/physics evaluation, metrics reduction and evaluation output IO separately where measurable.
timing.logging_and_io: Record checkpoint and metric serialization/write wall explicitly; identify nested/overlapping instrumentation and do not sum overlapping phase costs.
timing.installation: Runtime installation/source transfer excluded from per-run time; report allocation protocol wall separately from first smoke to final evaluation.
timing.smokes: Separate from production quality/speed aggregation, but retained with chronological startup/compile costs and full allocation protocol wall.
timing.probes: GPU telemetry/profiling outside primary iteration timings where feasible; never run a competing GPU process.
timing.inference: Actual deterministic evaluation policy forward time if recorded; do not call full environment-step time inference-only.
timing.checkpoint_replay_export: All11portable policy checkpoints omit replay. Final-only continuation-final at1000 exports full pristine learner/replay payload; its model/optimizer must equal final portable state. Export is included in final checkpoint/loop/process costs, with no extra scored evaluation.

checkpointing.resume_scope: All11portable checkpoints load on128evaluation worlds. The separate final checkpoint retains pristine official networks/Adam/scaler/normalizer/replay at1024training worlds; nstep1 has no delayed transitions. Authors save no simulator/global sampler RNG state, so exact trajectory restoration is not claimed.

accounting.turnover_scope: Capacity/steady insertion throughput only, not reconstructed replay age.600is before the10M fill and650after; all scheduled outcomes retained.
accounting.learning_rate: Keep existing3e-4 to1.5e-4 nonzero floor and12800per-optimizer attempted-call decay unchanged; do not stretch or restart for this pilot.
accounting.storage_note: Pristine replay save writes tensor views; backing storage can serialize the full480MB even in a partially filled large-buffer smoke. All actual artifacts/write costs retained.

audit.optimizer_counts: Each iteration/checkpoint and actual Adam/scaler state must match31806critic and15903actor/temperature attempts/run; completed+skipped=attempted. Nonzero AMP skips are reported, not erased or automatically unhealthy.
audit.pairing: Both capacity arms for each seed must load exact same canonical arrays. Same frozenMDP/assets/runtime/source and pristine author source across every case.
audit.one_factor: Paired executions may differ in capacity and case/seed/count bookkeeping only. No precision, reward, horizon, entropy, network, update or schedule change.
audit.checkpoint_reload: Every scored checkpoint is loaded and exact saved model hashes checked before deterministic common evaluation. Separate smokes perturb, restore exact optimizer/scaler payloads, then continue.
audit.missing_or_failed_run: Retain all raw outcomes and failures; no seed or checkpoint filtering. Poor balancing is an outcome, not workflow failure.
audit.public_privacy: Publish only whitelisted metrics/public source links/hashes/GPU model; no raw paths/UUID/internal hosts.

analysis.primary: Fixed-budget stability: full quality curves, first/ever/best/final and sustained900/1000; same unchanged gate.
analysis.best: Highest saved settled-upright fraction; clean completion then earlier checkpoint breaks ties. Best is not final or sustained success.
analysis.pairing: Compare large/small by seed0/1; retain all four outcomes and arm-specific AMP counts. Mean/observed min/max, no confidence intervals or quality noninferiority claim.
analysis.speed: Collection/learning/loop/fulltrainprocess/evaluation/export wall retained as secondary costs, not proof of better learning.
analysis.pilot_scope: Bounded1000iteration two-seed pilot, with no automatic longer run or further factor change. All four runs complete regardless quality.
